description: This file defines the DebugRuntime class for debugging purposes within the JmesPath library, providing functionalities to inspect tokens, AST, compiled code, and execution time during expression evaluation.

classes.name: DebugRuntime
classes.description: Provides CLI debugging information for the AST and Compiler runtimes within the JmesPath PHP implementation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DebugRuntime with a runtime callable and optional output stream.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes debugging for the provided expression and data, delegating to either debugCompiled or debugInterpreted based on the runtime type.

methods.name: debugInterpreted
methods.description: Runs the expression using an interpreted runtime with debugging output.

methods.name: debugCompiled
methods.description: Runs the expression with a compiled runtime, including dumping the compiled code.

methods.name: dumpTokens
methods.description: Tokenizes the expression and outputs the tokens.

methods.name: dumpAst
methods.description: Parses the expression into an AST and outputs it in pretty JSON format.

methods.name: dumpCompiledCode
methods.description: Loads and outputs the compiled PHP code corresponding to the expression from a temporary file.

methods.name: debugCallback
methods.description: Executes a debugging function while outputting expression, tokens, AST, data, result, and timing information.
